D04 replaces the curses wide-character fallback with UTF-8 VT output. Independent capture verifies complete graphemes and their terminal cell positions.
Python curses attribute arithmetic is retired under D04/D05. Terminal dimensions and generated frame bytes are bounded, with no pair identifiers or attribute overflow.

D05 retires Python import compatibility APIs for the TS product. Core ownership and deterministically generated Mod modules replace forwarding-export identity; generation drift and editor behavior remain tested.
D04 raw VT has no curses default-color initialization. Explicit SGR resets retain terminal default foreground/background without allocating a black fallback.
D04 raw VT eliminates curses pair allocation and its failure cache. Repeated monochrome output preserves sample text and terminal defaults without color allocation.
D04 raw VT eliminates the finite curses pair pool. Many distinct samples use bounded terminal palette indices; monochrome capability retains readable default text.
D04 raw VT has no start_color call. The supported monochrome capability produces the same text without foreground/background color sequences.
